mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which leads to increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% and 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% month-over-month signals increased economic activity and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST MoM > 5% and 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a slowdown in economic output, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM < -1% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over three consecutive months signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS increases for 3 consecutive months and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 month-over-month signals strong job growth, leading to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS MoM > 200,000 and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction between a decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and an increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS MoM < 0% and UNRATE MoM > 0% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of a high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 2%) and a low GDP growth rate (GDPC1 YoY < 2%) signals a restrictive monetary policy in a low-growth environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: low growth with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 2% and GDPC1 YoY < 2% and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.
